title: sprintiq belongs on your radar
description:
If your stack is getting messy, SprintiQ-Incorporated/sprintiq is worth a look. The product brain for AI coding agents. SprintiQ is an open-source agile platform built for AI assisted development. Turn ideas into AI-generated user stories, plan sprints, and ship via bidirectional sync with Claude Code. Single-user, self-hosted, Apache 2.0. It has about 39 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.
